opportunities.name: Propose a business-trip hotel and its cost in the traveler's home currency
opportunities.description: In the Booking.com tab, click the destination box, type {city}, set the dates {checkin} to {checkout} and click Search -> Open the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more and note its name and total price. Do not click Reserve or I'll reserve -> Switch to the xe.com tab, set Amount to that total price, From to EUR and To to {currency}, click Convert and read the result -> Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {traveler}@example.com, click Subject and type "Hotel for {city}, {checkin}-{checkout}" -> Click Body and type "Hi {traveler}, proposed hotel: <name>, <total> EUR (about <converted> {currency}). OK to book?" Do not click Send. Click Discard

opportunities.name: Check visa rules and local public holidays for a traveler's destination
opportunities.description: In the Wikipedia tab, click the search box, type "Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens" and open that article -> Find the row for {country} in the table and note the visa requirement and the allowed stay -> Switch to the timeanddate tab, open the Holidays menu, pick {country}, and note the public holidays in {month} -> Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{nationality} traveler to {country}: <requirement>, <allowed stay>. Holidays in {month}: <dates>" and press Enter

Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{nationality} traveler to {country}: <requirement>, <allowed stay>. Holidays in {month}: <dates>" and press Enter

opportunities.name: Send a traveler a weather and disruption heads-up before departure
opportunities.description: In the weather.com tab, click the search box, type {city}, pick it from the list and open the 10 Day forecast -> Note the high, low and conditions for {date} -> Switch to the BBC tab, click Search, type "{city} strike" and press Enter; open the first result and note its headline and date -> Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {traveler}@example.com, click Subject and type "Heads-up: {city} on {date}" -> Click Body and type "Hi {traveler}, {city} on {date}: <high>/<low>, <conditions>. Latest news: <headline> (<date>)." Do not click Send. Click Discard
